title: Impact of control signal phase noise on qubit fidelity
summary: As qubit decoherence times are increased and readout technologies are improved, nonidealities in the drive signals, such as phase noise, are going to represent a crucial limitation to the fidelity achievable at the end of complex control pulse sequences. Although the effect of phase noise of reference oscillators on qubit performance has been studied previously, its interaction with realistic time-dependent control pulses and its contribution to fidelity degradation have not yet been investigated in sufficient detail, and remains a critical challenge.
